title: Maxwell the Cat Theme
blurb: A frantic fiddle tune, a low-poly cat, and eternal rotation. Maxwell has been inserted into every video game, every music video and every corner of the internet — always spinning, always accompanied by this song, never explained. It is arguably the purest meme currently in circulation: there is no joke, no punchline and no context, just a cat and a fiddle and the collective decision that this is funny. That absence of content is precisely the appeal. Play it and something in the room will start rotating in sympathy.
origin: The theme attached to the viral spinning Maxwell the Cat 3D model.
